timeline.title: Last recovered entries
timeline.copy: The surviving catalog ends in January 2012.

recoveryNote: A partial recovery, August 2009–January 2012. Original snapshots remain linked throughout.
intro: The MuSiK Box was founded in Cleveland by Seamus Kelleher and Myles Snider and became In Audio We Trust in 2011. This archive brings together {{recordCount}} surviving post records, recovered artwork, interviews, and the history of the site from 2009 to 2012.
